units.literal: Zong Ze and Li Gang had chariot-warfare methods; Wang Dazhi presented a chariot pattern—all were no longer used, and attention turned to armor and the advantage of bows and arrows.

units.zh: 建炎初，上諭宰執曰：「方今戰士無慮三十萬，若皆被堅執銳，加以弧矢之利，雖強敵，無足畏也。
units.en: Early in Jianyan the emperor told his ministers: "Today's warriors number no less than three hundred thousand; if all wear stout armor and wield sharp weapons, and add the advantage of bows and arrows, even a strong enemy is not worth fearing.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan, the emperor instructed the chief ministers: "Today's warriors number no less than three hundred thousand; if all wear stout armor and wield sharp gear, adding the advantage of bows and arrows, even a strong enemy is not worth fearing.

units.zh: 造弓必用良工善價。」
units.en: Bow-making required skilled artisans and fair pay."
units.literal: Making bows must use skilled craftsmen and fair prices."

units.zh: 紹興三年，提舉製造軍器所言：「以七十工造全裝甲一。
units.en: In Shaoxing 3 the arms office reported: "Seventy artisans make one full suit of armor.
units.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, the office supervising military equipment manufacture said: "Seventy artisans make one full suit of armor.

units.zh: 又長齊頭甲每一甲用工百四十一，短齊頭甲用工七十四。
units.en: Long qitou armor required 141 artisans per suit; short qitou armor seventy-four.
units.literal: Also long qitou armor uses one hundred forty-one artisans per suit, short qitou armor seventy-four artisans.

units.zh: 乞以本所全裝甲為定式。」
units.en: They asked to standardize on the office's full armor pattern."
units.literal: We beg take this office's full armor as the fixed pattern."

units.zh: 席益言：「諸州造馬蝗弩，不若令造弓。」
units.en: Xi Yi said: "It would be better to order prefectures to make bows than horse-locust crossbows."
units.literal: Xi Yi said: "Prefectures making horse-locust crossbows are not as good as ordering bow manufacture.

units.zh: 詔並改造弓弩，內馬蝗弩改手射弓。
units.en: An edict ordered bow production instead; horse-locust crossbows became hand bows.
units.literal: An edict ordered all to remake bows and crossbows; inner horse-locust crossbows were changed to hand-drawn bows.

units.zh: 紹興四年，軍器所言：「得旨，依禦降式造甲。
units.en: In Shaoxing 4 the arms office reported: "Having received the decree, make armor according to the imperial pattern.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxing, the military equipment office said: "Having received the decree, make armor according to the imperially sent down pattern.

units.zh: 緣甲之式有四等，甲葉千八百二十五，表裏磨鋥。
units.en: Armor came in four grades with 1,825 polished lamellae inside and out.
units.literal: Because armor patterns have four grades, armor lamellae one thousand eight hundred twenty-five, inside and outside polished bright.

units.zh: 內披膊葉五百四，每葉重二錢六分；
units.en: Pauldrons used 504 lamellae at 2.6 qian each;
units.literal: Inner pauldron lamellae five hundred four, each lamella weighing two qian six fen;

units.zh: 又甲身葉三百三十二，每葉重四錢七分；
units.en: the cuirass 332 lamellae at 4.7 qian each;
units.literal: also body lamellae three hundred thirty-two, each lamella weighing four qian seven fen;

units.zh: 又腿裙鶻尾葉六百七十九，每葉重四錢五分；
units.en: tassets and skirt plates 679 lamellae at 4.5 qian each;
units.literal: also tassets and crane-tail lamellae six hundred seventy-nine, each lamella weighing four qian five fen;

units.zh: 又兜鍪簾葉三百一十，每葉重二錢五分。
units.en: and helmet curtains 310 lamellae at 2.5 qian each.
units.literal: also helmet curtain lamellae three hundred ten, each lamella weighing two qian five fen.

units.zh: 並兜鍪一，杯子、眉子共一斤一兩，皮線結頭等重五斤十二兩五錢有奇。
units.en: With helmet, bowl, and brow pieces totaling 1 jin 1 liang plus 5 jin 12.5 qian of cord and fittings.
units.literal: Together one helmet, bowl, and brow pieces totaling one jin one liang, leather cord knots and the like weighing five jin twelve liang five qian odd.

units.zh: 每一甲重四十有九斤十二兩。
units.en: Each suit weighed 49 jin 12 liang.
units.literal: Each suit of armor weighs forty-nine jin twelve liang.

units.zh: 若甲葉一一依元領分兩，如重輕差殊，即棄不用，虛費工材。
units.en: If lamellae were required one by one to match the originally allotted weights, whenever heavy and light differed they were discarded unused, wasting labor and materials.
units.literal: If lamellae one by one follow the original allotted weight and the heavy and light differ, they are discarded unused, wasting labor and materials.

units.zh: 乞以新式甲葉分兩輕重通融，全裝共四十五斤至五十斤止。」
units.en: They proposed flexible lamella weights totaling 45–50 jin per suit."
units.literal: We beg use the new-pattern lamella weights heavy and light in comprehensive balance; full armor altogether from forty-five jin to fifty jin stop."

units.zh: 詔勿過五十斤。
units.en: The court capped armor at fifty jin.
units.literal: An edict: do not exceed fifty jin.

units.zh: 三十二年，詔江東安撫司造木弩五千、箭五十萬。
units.en: In the thirty-second year Jiangdong was ordered to produce 5,000 wooden crossbows and 500,000 arrows.
units.literal: In the thirty-second year, an edict ordered the Jiangdong Pacification Commission to make five thousand wooden crossbows and five hundred thousand arrows.

units.zh: 隆興元年，御降木羽弩箭式，每路依式製箭百萬。
units.en: In Longxing 1 each circuit was ordered to make one million wooden-feathered bolts to imperial pattern.
units.literal: In the first year of Longxing, an imperially sent wooden-feathered crossbow bolt pattern; each circuit made one million bolts according to the pattern.

units.zh: 淳熙九年，衢州守臣製到木鶴觜弩二千、箭十萬。
units.en: In Chunxi 9 Quzhou produced 2,000 wooden crane-beak crossbows and 100,000 arrows.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Chunxi, the Quzhou prefectural official made two thousand wooden crane-beak crossbows and one hundred thousand arrows.

units.zh: 又湖北、京西造納無羽箭。
units.en: Hubei and Jingxi also presented featherless arrows.
units.literal: Also Hubei and Jingxi delivered featherless arrows.

units.zh: 上曰：「箭不用羽，可謂精巧，其屋藏之。」
units.en: The emperor said: "Arrows without feathers can be called ingenious; store them in the armory."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Arrows without feathers can be called ingenious; store them in the armory."

units.zh: 淮東總領朱佺言：「鎮江一軍，乃韓世忠部曲。
units.en: Huaidong chief steward Zhu Qian reported: "The Zhenjiang army is Han Shizhong's old command.
units.literal: Huaidong chief steward Zhu Qian said: "The Zhenjiang army is Han Shizhong's old command.

units.zh: 世忠造克敵弓，以當敵騎衝突，其發可至百步，其勁可穿重甲，最為利器。
units.en: Shizhong's enemy-defeating bow, designed to stop cavalry charges, shot one hundred paces and pierced heavy armor.
units.literal: Shizhong made the enemy-defeating bow to counter enemy cavalry charges; its shot can reach one hundred paces, its force can pierce heavy armor—it is the sharpest tool.

units.zh: 往歲調發，弓不免損失，存者歲久亦漸弛壞。
units.en: Past deployments had depleted and damaged the bows.
units.literal: In former years when mobilized, bows could not avoid loss; those remaining after years gradually also loosened and broke.

units.zh: 今考諸軍見弩手八千八百四十二人，人合用兩弓，一弓一日上教，一弓備出戰，合用弓萬七千六百八十有四，僅存六千五百七十有四，餘皆不堪施教，乞下鎮江都統司足其額。」
units.en: He counted 8,842 crossbowmen needing 17,684 bows but found only 6,574 serviceable and asked Zhenjiang headquarters to fill the gap."
units.literal: Now examining the various armies' present crossbowmen eight thousand eight hundred forty-two men, each man should use two bows—one bow for daily drill, one bow prepared for battle—altogether should use seventeen thousand six hundred eighty-four bows; only six thousand five hundred seventy-four remain, the rest all unfit for drill instruction; we beg the Zhenjiang command headquarters fill the quota."

units.zh: 十五年，工部侍郎李昌圖言：「弓矢之利，貴於便疾。
units.en: In the fifteenth year Li Changtu, vice minister of works, said: "The advantage of bow and arrow lies in convenience and swiftness.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, Vice Minister of Works Li Changtu said: "The advantage of bow and arrow lies in being convenient and swift.

units.zh: 神臂弓鬥力及遠，屢獲其用。
units.en: The divine-arm crossbow's range had repeatedly proved valuable.
units.literal: The divine-arm crossbow's draw strength reaches far and has repeatedly proved useful.

units.zh: 後又又造神勁弓，及遠雖在神臂弓上，軍中多言其發遲，每神臂三矢而神勁方能一發，若臨敵之際，便疾反出神臂下。」
units.en: The newer divine-power bow shot farther but slower—three divine-arm shots per one divine-power shot—making it inferior in combat."
units.literal: Later they also made the divine-power bow; though its range exceeded the divine-arm crossbow, many in the army said its release was slow—every three divine-arm shots the divine-power could fire once; if facing the enemy, swiftness in fact fell below the divine-arm."

units.zh: 上曰：「平原曠野宜用神勁弓，西蜀崇山峻嶺，未知孰利。」
units.en: The emperor said: "Open plains suit the divine-power bow; western Shu has lofty mountains and steep ridges—which is more advantageous is unknown."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Open plains and broad fields suit the divine-power bow; western Shu has lofty mountains and steep ridges—which is advantageous is unknown."

units.zh: 詔金州都統司詳議以聞。
units.en: Jinzhou headquarters was ordered to investigate and report.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Jinzhou command headquarters to deliberate in detail and report.

units.zh: 既而都統製吳挺奏：「神勁弓並彈子頭箭，諸軍用之誠便疾，神臂不及也。」
units.en: Wu Ting of Jinzhou then reported: "The divine-power bow with pellet-headed arrows is truly swift in army use; the divine-arm cannot match it."
units.literal: Before long Overall Commander Wu Ting memorialized: "The divine-power bow with pellet-head arrows—in the armies' use it is truly convenient and swift; the divine-arm cannot match it."

units.zh: 詔從其便。
units.en: The court approved local preference.
units.literal: An edict followed their convenience.

units.zh: 楚州兵馬鈐轄言：「弩之力，勁者三十石，次者十五石，矢之鏃狀若鍬，所發何啻數百步，洞穿數人。
units.en: Chuzhou's military commissioner said: "Crossbow power—the strong draws thirty stone, the next fifteen; the arrowheads are shaped like spades; their shots fly hundreds of paces and pierce several men through.
units.literal: The Chuzhou military commissioner said: "Crossbow power—the strong draws thirty stone, the next fifteen stone; the arrowheads shaped like spades; what they shoot is no less than several hundred paces, piercing several men through.

units.zh: 江上諸軍有弩式，皆廢不修。」
units.en: Yangzi armies had crossbow patterns but left them unmaintained."
units.literal: Armies along the river have crossbow patterns, all abandoned and unrepaired."

units.zh: 詔兩淮、荊襄沿邊城守，各製二十枝，御前軍器所亦如之。
units.en: Two Huai and Jing-Xiang garrisons and the Imperial Arms Office were each ordered to build twenty.
units.literal: An edict ordered the two Huai and Jing-Xiang frontier garrisons each to make twenty; the Imperial Military Equipment Office likewise.

units.zh: 紹熙而後，日造器械，數目山積。
units.en: After Shaoxi arms production piled up endlessly.
units.literal: After Shaoxi, daily manufacture of gear piled numbers like mountains.

units.zh: 開慶元年，壽春府造㔶筒木弩，與常弩明牙發不同，箭置筒內甚穩，尤便夜中施發。
units.en: In Kaiqing 1 Shouchun built tube wooden crossbows with internal bolts, especially suited to night firing.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaiqing, Shouchun Prefecture made tube wooden crossbows, different from regular crossbows in clear tooth release; arrows placed inside the tube very steady, especially convenient for firing at night.

units.zh: 又造突火槍，以世竹為筒，內安子窠，如燒放，焰絕然後子窠發出，如炮聲，遠聞百五十餘步。
units.en: They also made fire lances: bamboo tubes with pellet chambers that, after the flame died, discharged with a report heard 150 paces away.
units.literal: They also made fire-lance guns, using bamboo as tubes, installing pellet nests inside; when fired like a torch, after the flame died the pellet nest shot out like cannon sound, heard more than one hundred fifty paces distant.

units.zh: 咸淳九年，沿邊州郡，因降式製回回炮，有觸類巧思，別置炮遠出其上。
units.en: In Xianchun 9 frontier commands built Muslim trebuchets from imperial patterns; some innovators built even longer-range versions.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Xianchun, frontier prefectures and commands, following sent-down patterns, made Muslim trebuchets; some with ingenious analogies separately placed trebuchets shooting farther still.

units.zh: 且為破炮之策尤奇。
units.en: They also devised ingenious counter-trebuchet defenses.
units.literal: Moreover the strategy for defeating trebuchets was especially ingenious.

units.zh: 其法，用稻穰草成堅索，條圍四寸，長三十四尺，每二十條為束，別以麻索繫一頭於樓後柱，搭過樓，下垂至地，栿梁垂四層或五層，周庇樓屋，沃以泥漿，火箭火炮不能侵，炮石雖百鈞無所施矣。
units.en: Rice-straw ropes four inches thick and thirty-four feet long, bundled in twenties and hung from tower pillars through multiple beam layers plastered with mud, blocked fire arrows and stones up to 100 jun.
units.literal: The method: use rice-straw grass to make stout ropes, strips four inches in circumference, thirty-four feet long, every twenty strips as a bundle, separately tie one end with hemp rope to a rear pillar of the tower, pass over the tower, hang down to the ground, beam layers four or five deep surrounding the tower building, daubed with mud slurry—fire arrows and fire cannon cannot penetrate; trebuchet stones though one hundred jun have nowhere to apply force.

units.zh: 且輕便不費財，立名曰「護陴籬索」。
units.en: Light and cheap, they named the device "Rampart-Protecting Hedge Rope."
units.literal: Moreover light and convenient without wasting wealth; they established the name "Rampart-Protecting Hedge Rope."

units.zh: 是時兵紀不振，獨器甲視舊制益詳。
units.en: Though military discipline had collapsed, regulations for arms and armor had grown more detailed than ever.
units.literal: At that time military discipline was not restored, yet weapons and armor alone compared with the old system were more detailed.
